system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Open building footprints detected from satellite imagery using machine learning across multiple countries and regions worldwide. The dataset contains 777M+ buildings detected from Bing Maps imagery.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2014 to 2021 - static snapshot representing building footprints detected from imagery acquired during this period
data_description.spatial_resolution: Building-level vector polygons with precise boundary delineation
data_description.records: Global coverage with 777M+ building polygons across multiple countries; regional coverage varies by country with complete coverage for many regions including Australia, Chile, and numerous other countries
data_description.data_type_numeric: Building footprint geometry (polygon area); inspect feature properties for building area, confidence scores, and location attributes.

vector_content.thematic_group: Global Utilities, Assets and Amenities Layers

data_description.important_note: This dataset was created by Microsoft using computer vision and deep learning techniques applied to Bing Maps satellite imagery (including Maxar and Airbus imagery). The building footprints provide precise polygon boundaries for individual structures. The dataset is organized by country/region, with each region available as a separate asset. Building footprints are valuable for population estimation, infrastructure planning, disaster response, and urban analysis.
analytical_capabilities: Building density and urban morphology analysis
Building footprint area statistics and built-up area calculation

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Building footprint polygon geometry with area in square meters
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Each feature represents an individual building polygon. Calculate area using geometry methods. The dataset is organized by country - check available regions and select appropriate asset IDs for your study area.

data_description.data_source: Microsoft & Bing Maps via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
